security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Keeps a copy of a folder in step with the original.
bundle.longDescription: Dupli compares two folders and copies, moves and removes only what differs, on external drives, memory sticks and network shares. Files it takes away are kept in a history folder so they can be restored.
